title: Diagonal Squeeze
setup: Your king and queen are stacked on the h-file, and Black's king is trapped in the corner. The mate comes from the side.
hint: One tempting queen move takes every square away without giving check, which is stalemate. Give check from where your king still covers g7.
explanation:
## The Idea

The natural-looking {{Qg6}} is stalemate: no check, and no legal move for Black, so half a point is gone. {{Qe8#}} checks along the back rank instead. g8 is on the queen's line, your king on h6 covers g7 and h7, and nothing can capture the queen or block.

With a queen against a bare king, make sure your move gives check before you take away the last square.
